rationale: Peter's 18+ years building clinical-grade health applications with AI and wearables pairs well with AJ's hardware-software co-design expertise in robotics manipulation. While Peter focuses on digital health diagnostics and AJ on dexterous robotic systems, both share deep conviction in combining embedded systems with machine learning to solve real-world problems—and both have the systems engineering chops (Peter's telecommunications and embedded background, AJ's robotics hardware focus) to execute at that level.
intro_message: Peter Kuhar, meet AJ Chahal — both of you are building hardware-software systems that require tight integration of machine learning with physical devices, and you share a conviction that deep technical co-design is essential to shipping products that actually work in practice.
